short: Squared norm bound for off-diagonal period blocks

lean.name: Formalism.L2.SG.TheoremS.pbApplied
lean.plain: Squared norm bound for off-diagonal period blocks
lean.note: For sufficiently large rank, the three row estimates imply that the squared norm of the off-diagonal block is at most $1+b^{-6}$ times $d_ud_{u'}/D^*$. The large and nonscalar rows each have an error bound decaying with $kf\log k$, while the nongeneric rows have a separate bound with the factor $2^{-(k-2r-5)}$.
